name: Night Drop
briefing:
## Situation
Night, clear. Depot Bravo sits a few kilometres from a border line. Heavy quadcopters have been crossing at night, hovering briefly and dropping packages before flying back. Birds and our own patrol drone are also up.
## Mission
Detect the crossing, identify it, and defeat it before it drops its payload near Depot Bravo. Leave birds and friendlies alone.

## Intel
Crossings expected from the south-east. The courier drone is RF-controlled: an RF bearing may come before a radar track. The day camera is blind at night; use IR to identify.
